== Biography ==

The Princess is addressed by this title in scenes tied to Ozma's court and to Dorothy's status within Oz. Ozma is shown possessing a Magic Picture that lets her view any part of the world she wishes and watch anyone she is interested in; through it she once observed Dorothy in her Kansas home, and on another occasion she used it daily to inspect the progress of a tunnel being dug, a task she considered her duty even though it was not especially interesting to her. Ozma is directly addressed as "Princess" by her companions, including a remark from the Shaggy Man agreeing that reforming the wicked people mattered more than saving Oz.

The title is also applied to Dorothy, who dressed in her prettiest gown and put on her coronet before a dinner with the Scarecrow, the Tin Woodman, and Jack Pumpkinhead, thinking it might be the last time she would appear as a Princess of Oz. Separately, a rabbit wearing a monocle addressed Dorothy as "Princess" while informing her that her companions could not enter Bunnybury with her.
